name: Ferienwohnung Kirchmair
beschreibung:
Idylllically located near Lake Thiersee, Ferienwohnung Kirchmair provides a relaxing haven for families and couples, featuring a balcony with mountain views.

The lake offers water sports and swimming in summer, while hiking paths up Mount Pendling start right outside.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kirchmair in Thiersee offers lakeside proximity and comfortable holiday lodgings in Kufsteinerland.
